name: Spiral Rubbing
desc: A pencil rubbing of a spiral carving from the mound at Bryn Celli Ddu, on a page torn from a notebook. The spiral is about five thousand years older than the notebook.

name: Cave Shell
desc: A blue-black mussel shell from the floor of Merlin's Cave, polished by the swell and left open like a small book. It still smells faintly of the Atlantic.

name: Bottle of Cave Drip
desc: A small bottle of water from the Great Stalactite's drip at Doolin. It is faintly chalky, which is limestone on its way to becoming a stalactite. Leave the real ones alone.

name: Bar of Soap
desc: Plain soap in waxed paper, sent back up the Severn on request from a town in Bath that asked for it. Please do not send it back.
